dok_warrior_gold: the same dokkaebi warrior as a rare GOLDEN variant: skin warm clay with gilded highlights, club and bands in burnished gold-brass, a small gold bell, vest trimmed in ochre-gold; same body, pose language and face
dok_warrior_new_year: the same dokkaebi warrior dressed for the Lunar New Year (Seollal): a bright but muted saekdong striped sleeve vest, a small bokjumeoni luck pouch on the belt, a red-and-gold tassel on the club; same body and face, festive cheerful grin
gumiho_spring: the same gumiho guardian as a spring cherry-blossom variant: pale pink blossom sprigs in the fur and on the tails, a soft blush-pink robe with ivory lining, drifting petals in the foxfire; same fox body and tail count
gumiho_frost: the same gumiho guardian as a winter frost variant: silver-white fur with frost-blue tail tips, an ice-blue robe with pale silver embroidery, a frost crystal instead of foxfire; same fox body and tail count
flame_blue: the same fire dokkaebi as a blue-flame variant: the fire turned into cool cobalt-blue flames, darker slate clay skin with blue ember seams, bronze fittings unchanged; same body and pose language
frost_aurora: the same frost mountain spirit as an aurora variant: frosted pine crown shimmering with soft green-violet aurora ribbons, a night-indigo shawl with faint star specks; same stout elder body
hermit_golden: the same sage as a golden hermit variant: a pale gold-ivory robe with sun-brass trim, a golden gourd and a golden peach at the belt, soft warm glow; same old face and beard
tiger_shadow: the same white tiger swordsman as a black-tiger (heukho) variant: ink-black fur with charcoal stripes and pale gold eyes, a dark indigo sash, blade edge glinting silver; same tiger body
death_silver: the same death messenger as a silver variant: robe and broad gat in pale silver-grey with moonlit highlights, lantern light turned cool silver-white; same tall tapering silhouette
little_dok_summer: the same junior dokkaebi dressed for summer: a light hemp short jacket, a straw sun hat pushed back on the horns, a slice of watermelon in one hand and a small fan; same small body and grin
tortoise_jade: the same golden turtle as a jade variant: shell and skin in deep jade green with celadon highlights, gold fittings turned pale bronze, small jade pendant; same turtle body
crow_solar: the same three-legged crow as a solar variant: feathers edged in sunrise gold and ember orange, a brighter sun-brass disk behind it; same three legs and pose
dancer_midnight: the same mask dancer as a midnight variant: dancing sleeves and costume in deep night-indigo with silver moon threads, the carved mask painted pale moon-white; same dancing stance
eternal_crow: the same three-legged crow as an eternal legendary variant: iridescent black-violet feathers, a pale ivory-gold halo ring instead of the sun disk, faint star specks trailing; same three legs
divine_warrior: the same dokkaebi warrior as a celestial (heavenly) variant: pale cloud-thread armour pieces with sun-brass trim over the vest, a faint halo ring behind the horns, club bound in white cloud braid; same body and face
void_death: the same death messenger as a void variant: robe of ink glass and ash cloth with controlled gaps, the lantern holding a dark crystal with violet edge light; same tapering silhouette and broad gat
sage_primordial: the same sage as a primordial variant: robe of cracked relic-stone texture with ember seams and roots trailing from the hem, staff of fossil wood; same old face and beard
